title: Hillenkoetter frustrated at being kept in the dark about Roswell

tellings.quote: it's so interesting because I think he was frustrated at not getting the proper information about Roswell.

plain: Roscoe Hillenkoetter, an early head of the CIA, was frustrated that he never got the proper information about Roswell, the reported 1947 crash of an object in the New Mexico desert. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, and mentions him alongside Donald Keyhoe, a writer on UFOs. If true, it would mean even a top intelligence chief was kept out of the loop.
